script.title: Will EPFO Invest Your PF in Startups? #shorts

segments.text: Your monthly PF deduction could soon fund Indian startups.
Right now, EPFO manages huge retirement savings, mostly putting money into safe government bonds.
That safe investment earns you around eight percent annual interest.
So why risk investing retirement cash into tech startups?
Simple. Early startup bets can deliver high multi-fold returns over long cycles.
Strict caps will ensure only a tiny fraction goes to high-risk funds. Not financial advice.
So next time you see your pay slip, remember...
